2026_04_ARI_NYG.headline: Arizona’s drive-building offense tests a Giants team recalibrating around Jameis Winston
2026_04_ARI_NYG.paragraph1: Arizona heads to MetLife with Jacoby Brissett directing an offense that has leaned on volume and rookie Jeremiyah Love, while Mike LaFleur looks for cleaner finishes after the narrow loss in San Francisco. New York is still recalibrating around Jameis Winston after Jaxson Dart’s season-ending knee injury, and Andrew Thomas’ groin issue adds another concern up front. John Harbaugh’s defense kept the Giants steady last week, making protection, field position and Arizona’s ability to sustain drives the central matchup.
2026_04_ARI_NYG.model_rationale: Arizona can stress New York by extending possessions, but the Giants’ defensive structure and Winston’s ball security give them a path to control field position and tempo.
